conceptZh: 小玩具機器人蓋好一間迷你小屋，退後欣賞了一下，走到門口才發現門小到只能伸進一隻手；他想了想，直接把屋頂掀開、從上面爬進去，再從煙囪探出頭來開心地揮手。
object: a small toy robot and a tiny toy house
morph: the glyph 家 stands still as a solid sculpture while the robot moves into the little house beside it
creativeAngle: 家是孩子每天講的字，笑點用「自己蓋的房子門太小」的規劃失誤，加上從屋頂爬進去的務實解法，收在煙囪揮手很溫暖。家為宀頭加豕共十畫，豕正好和剛學的豬互相連結，字體靜止保結構。語音詞「家人」，人ㄖㄣˊ已學過，兩字都是單一讀音。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale cream background. One correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 家 stands centered the whole time as a flat-fronted sculpture in saturated deep forest green, filling about 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins on all sides. Use standard textbook proportions: the 宀 roof radical on top covers the 豕 component below, both clearly separated, with the strokes of 豕 kept apart and readable. The glyph never moves, rotates, tilts or gets covered, and the camera stays locked. Beside its base stands a tiny toy house, and a small boxy toy robot sets the last brick on its chimney at 0.6 seconds. He steps back, tilts his head, and admires it with his hands on his hips. At 1.5 seconds he walks proudly to the front door and discovers it is barely bigger than his hand; he posts one arm through it up to the shoulder, then pulls it back out. He looks at the door. He looks at himself. Beat. At 2.6 seconds he simply lifts the entire roof off like a lid, steps inside, and lowers the roof back down over himself with great care. Silence. At 3.6 seconds his head pops up out of the chimney, grinning, and he waves cheerfully. At 4.4 seconds he ducks back down and the little house is carried quietly out of frame to the left. From 4.7 seconds to 8.0 seconds the frame is completely still and clean, holding on the single centered 家 with nothing else in shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「家、家、家人」, using the reading ㄐㄧㄚ for 家 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 家 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 家人 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 家: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 家是回去休息、和家人在一起的地方
object: a squad of glossy interlocking building bricks and one tiny yellow brick scout
morph: a tiny brick drags one gigantic blue brick home and it becomes the roof stroke of 家, then the squad stacks the pig-shaped lower part under it
creativeAngle: 積木小隊的最小兵扛著比自己大十倍的屋頂磚回家，大小差距就是笑點；詞用「回家」，最後小兵坐進家字下方打哈欠。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D animated toy clip on a clean solid pale cream backdrop, one locked camera. The only text in the frame is a single Traditional Chinese glyph 家, built from glossy interlocking bricks in saturated deep teal, centered and filling about 70 percent of the frame height with even margins. Cast: a squad of chunky building bricks with painted dot eyes, led by a tiny yellow 1x1 brick scout named Pip. Moment one, 0 to 1.8s: Pip hops in from the left dragging a gigantic blue 2x10 brick behind him on a string, three times his own length, and he is soon squashed flat under one end, legs pedaling. The voice says the first 家 as he strains. Moment two, 1.8 to 3.6s: Pip tries to push the long brick up a ramp of red bricks, it overshoots and spins him like a propeller, then four orange 2x2 bricks march in, hoist the beam together, and set it on top as the flat roof dot-and-bar of 家, the top radical 宀. The second 家 is spoken as it clicks into place. Moment three, 3.6 to 5.0s: the lower half of the character, the 豕 part with its horizontal bar, hooked tail strokes and four small legs, assembles as bricks rain neatly into columns, each landing with a bouncy squish and little eyes blinking open on a few of them. Pip leans on the crooked roof with his whole body until it clicks level. Moment four, 5.0s: the squad cheers. From 5.0 to 8.0s the glyph is perfectly still and fully readable with no brick overlapping its strokes, while Pip sits on the empty cream floor well below it, yawns, and slowly curls into a snooze with a tiny wobble of his stud, never touching the character. Audio: a warm friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「家、家、回家」, read syllable by syllable slowly with clear tones as ㄐㄧㄚ、ㄐㄧㄚ、ㄏㄨㄟˊ ㄐㄧㄚ. The first 家 lands near 0.7s, the second near 2.3s, and 回家 around 5.2s as Pip curls up happy and sleepy. Stop after the word, no extra chanting. Only soft brick click sounds, no background music. Rendering: soft studio light, vivid not neon colors, no flashing, no lens flare, no motion blur on the glyph, no watermark, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, and no text other than the one glyph 家.
